decisions.reason: The option remains cheap to keep because it leverages the firm's core secure communication capability and its prospects are still uncertain enough to retain.
Its foundational architecture provides option value across multiple future offerings and the cost of keeping it open is low relative to its strategic importance.
Hardware token costs remain high and its option value has declined as the firm shifts toward mobile and software-based security, so we drop it.
Regulatory demand for payment security remains strong and the product fits the firm's existing suite, so the option is still valuable to keep.
